en: Model and reasoning choices are isolated per conversation. Changing one conversation no longer changes other existing conversations or their next execution.

New conversations inherit the last manually chosen Codex model and reasoning level. Existing conversations retain explicit choices and recover their last recorded execution settings where available; Fast controls use the current conversation’s selection.
zh: 模型与思考等级按会话独立保存，修改一个会话不再带动其他已有会话的显示或下一次执行。
新会话沿用最近手动选择的Codex模型与思考等级；旧会话保留明确设置，并在有记录时保留上次实际执行选择。Fast开关使用本会话的模型配置。
